text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan and Yaeno Muteki's resolves are firm. Sakura Chiyono O is reminded anew of the dream Maruzensky entrusted to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whether out of determination or desperation, she begins training in secret… which unfortunately leads to her injuring her leg.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tries to keep the injury a secret from me, but I take her to her family home, hoping she'll be able to concentrate on recovering away from the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I understand why she doesn't want to lose to her rivals, but that's no reason to overstrain herself and potentially shorten her racing career.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O seems to take this to heart and rehabilitates while surrounded by her loving family. She's determined to continue improving, however, much to the detriment of her family home's tatami mats.
